description: Every built-in string the panel shows; `labels` overrides any of them.

done.description: The header once done when the host gives no time.

failed.description: The header once failed, the same way: «تعثّر بعد ٦ث».

more.description: The sources past the chips shown, `count` in the reader's digits: «+٢».

searched.description: Before the sources the search covered: «بحث في».

showAll.description: Said after «+٢» in the button's name, so it reads «+٢ عرض كل المصادر».

showFewer.description: The same button once every source shows.

stepStates.description: Each step's hidden state word, beside its icon.

stopped.description:
The header once stopped, around the time it ran: «أُوقف بعد ٦ث». `elapsed`
is empty when the host gives no time, and then it is the bare word.

thinking.description: The header while running, and the one sentence announced for it.

thought.description: The header once done, around the time it took: «فكّر لمدة ٦ث».
